def setup_owned_ecg(client, account, monkeypatch):
    from otgd import operator_governance as g

    monkeypatch.setitem(g.SOFTWARE_ADAPTERS, "ecg", {"otgd_signed_reader_v1"})
    monkeypatch.setitem(g.PHYSICAL_DRIVERS, "ecg", {"otgd_esp32_adc_v1"})
    f = fixture()
    private = f.private
    material = f.config["material"]
    body = configuration(
        "ecg",
        material=material,
        sha256=digest(material),
        max_duration_ms=1000,
        software_adapter_id="otgd_signed_reader_v1",
        raw_retention_approved=True,
        device_id=DEVICE,
        key_id=KEY,
        calibration_id=CALIBRATION,
        approved_hardware=["fixture-hw"],
        approved_firmware=["fixture-fw"],
    )
    with factory().begin() as db:
        for kind, item in (
            ("study", study(account, {"ecg": body["registry_id"]})),
            ("retention", retention()),
            ("device", device(account, private)),
            ("calibration", calibration()),
            ("qualification", proof("ecg", body)),
            ("configuration", body),
        ):
            approve(db, kind, item)
        config = g.active_body(db, "configuration", body["registry_id"])
        policy = g.active_body(db, "retention", POLICY)
    receipt = consent(client, study(account))
    pref = client.post(
        f"/v1/studies/{STUDY}/raw-recording-preferences",
        headers=headers(),
        json={
            "consent_record_id": receipt["consent_record_id"],
            "policy_id": POLICY,
            "policy_version": "v1",
            "policy_sha256": digest(policy),
            "raw_notice_version": policy["raw_notice_version"],
            "raw_notice_sha256": policy["raw_notice_sha256"],
            "acknowledged_at": iso(),
            "choices": {
                "eye_video": {"record": False, "upload": False},
                "ecg_waveform": {"record": True, "upload": True},
            },
        },
    )
    assert pref.status_code == 201, pref.text
    challenge = client.post(
        "/v1/device-bindings/challenges",
        headers=headers(),
        json={"device_id": DEVICE, "key_id": KEY},
    ).json()
    sig = base64.b64encode(
        private.sign(
            b"OTGD-BIND-v1\n" + canonical(challenge["transcript"]),
            ec.ECDSA(hashes.SHA256()),
        )
    ).decode()
    binding = client.post(
        "/v1/device-bindings",
        headers=headers(),
        json={"challenge_id": challenge["challenge_id"], "signature": sig},
    ).json()
    sid, aid, rid = (str(uuid4()) for _ in range(3))
    boot = str(uuid4())
    assert (
        client.post(
            "/v1/sessions",
            headers=headers(),
            json={
                "session_id": sid,
                "mode": "controlled_research",
                "study_id": STUDY,
                "protocol_id": PROTOCOL,
            },
        ).status_code
        == 201
    )
    context = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "session_id": sid,
        "context_confirmed_at": iso(),
        "profile_version_id": None,
        "profile_snapshot_sha256": "a" * 64,
        "history_snapshot_sha256": "b" * 64,
        "protocol_id": PROTOCOL,
        "configuration_refs": [
            {
                "id": config["registry_id"],
                "version": "v1",
                "sha256": config["sha256"],
                "scope": "measurement_collection",
            }
        ],
        "baseline_refs": [],
        "self_report_context": None,
        "device_associations": [
            {
                **{
                    k: binding[k]
                    for k in (
                        "binding_id",
                        "device_id",
                        "hardware_revision",
                        "firmware_version",
                    )
                },
                "boot_id": boot,
                "clock_evidence_ref": None,
            }
        ],
    }
    assert (
        client.put(
            f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/context", headers=headers(revision=0), json=context
        ).status_code
        == 200
    )
    attempt = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "session_id": sid,
        "attempt_id": aid,
        "component": "cardiac",
        "record_id": rid,
        "supersedes_attempt_id": None,
        "status": "started",
        "source": "prototype_sensor",
        "started_at": iso(),
        "ended_at": None,
        "configuration_id": config["registry_id"],
        "configuration_hash": config["sha256"],
        "quality_flags": [],
        "component_metadata": {"modality": "ecg"},
        "artifact_refs": [],
        "attestation_refs": [],
    }
    assert (
        client.put(
            f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/attempts/{aid}",
            headers=headers(revision=0),
            json=attempt,
        ).status_code
        == 200
    )
    from otgd.operator_governance import active_body
    with factory()() as db:
        approved_config = active_body(db, "configuration", config["registry_id"])
    instruction = acknowledge_cardiac(client, sid, attempt, approved_config)
    grant = client.post(
        f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/capture-authorizations",
        headers=headers(),
        json={
            "attempt_id": aid,
            "channel": "ecg",
            "binding_id": binding["binding_id"],
            "device_id": DEVICE,
            "configuration_id": config["registry_id"],
            "configuration_hash": config["sha256"],
            "raw_recording_kind": "ecg_waveform",
            "instruction_receipt_id": instruction["instruction_receipt_id"],
        },
    ).json()
    start = client.post(
        f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/capture-authorizations/{grant['authorization_id']}/start",
        headers=headers(),
        json={
            "attempt_id": aid,
            "device_boot_id": boot,
            "device_nonce": base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b"N" * 32).decode().rstrip("="),
        },
    )
    assert start.status_code == 200, start.text
    began = start.json()["server_started_at"]
    ended = iso(now() + 0.9)
    attid = str(uuid4())
    projection = {
        "status": "invalid",
        "source": "prototype_sensor",
        "started_at": began,
        "ended_at": ended,

def test_roi_same_pixel_summary_cannot_hide_changed_content_and_statistics_cannot_be_forged():
    import hashlib

    payload, attempt, config = roi_fixture()
    raw = bytearray(payload)
    raw[36] ^= 1  # changes an outside luminance pixel without changing component area
    with pytest.raises(Problem) as error:

    attempt["component_metadata"]["native_result"]["frame_events"][0][
        "roi_luma_sha256"

    with pytest.raises(Problem):

def test_signed_reader_transport_and_recording_approval_cannot_invent_a_sampling_driver_or_raw_codec(monkeypatch):
    from pydantic import ValidationError
    from otgd import operator_governance as governance
    from .governance_fixture import adc_material, acknowledge_cardiac

    generic = configuration("cardiac", software_adapter_id="otgd_signed_reader_v1")
    monkeypatch.setitem(governance.SOFTWARE_ADAPTERS, "cardiac", {"otgd_signed_reader_v1"})
    assert not governance.software_supported(generic)
    monkeypatch.setitem(governance.PHYSICAL_DRIVERS, "cardiac", {"otgd_esp32_adc_v1"})
    assert not governance.software_supported(generic)
    adc = {**generic, "material": adc_material()}
    assert governance.software_supported(adc)
    assert not governance.raw_recording_supported(adc, "ecg_waveform")
    waveform = {**adc_material("ecg"), "duration_ms": 1000, "sample_rate_hz": 20,
        "raw_unit": "mV", "raw_sample_limit": 20, "raw_encoding": "otgd_ecg_samples_v1"}
    assert governance.ADCMaterial.model_validate(waveform).raw_sample_limit == 20
    assert governance.raw_recording_supported({**adc, "channel": "ecg", "material": waveform}, "ecg_waveform")
    assert not governance.software_supported({**adc, "channel": "ecg", "material": {**waveform, "raw_unit": "counts"}})
    assert not governance.raw_recording_supported({**adc, "channel": "ecg", "material": {**waveform, "raw_unit": "counts"}}, "ecg_waveform")
    for changed in ({"raw_sample_limit": 0}, {"raw_encoding": None}, {"sample_rate_hz": 1000},
        {"channel": "cardiac", "modality": "ppg"}):
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            governance.ADCMaterial.model_validate({**waveform, **changed})

def test_only_private_rsa3072_build_key_is_admitted(tmp_path):
    path = key_file(
        tmp_path / "build.pem",
        rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=3072),

    path.chmod(0o644)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        helper.private_key(path)
    path.chmod(0o600)
    symlink = tmp_path / "link.pem"

    with pytest.raises(OSError):
        helper.private_key(symlink)
    os.link(path, tmp_path / "second.pem")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

def test_retained_deletion_blocks_restored_active_database_even_without_restore_flag(
    journal,
):
    authority = r.load_authority(journal.cfg, journal.instant)
    with database(journal, restored=True) as db:
        with pytest.raises(r.RecoveryBlocked, match="accepted deletion"):
            r.verify_database_authority(db, authority, False)
    with database(journal) as db:
        assert r.verify_database_authority(db, authority, False) == 0

def database(j, restored=False, recovery=None):
    eng = create_engine("sqlite://")
    Base.metadata.create_all(eng)
    db = Session(eng)
    db.add(
        Account(
            id=ACCOUNT,
            subject_hash=SUBJECT,
            generation=1 if restored else 2,
            state="active" if restored else "deleted",
        )
    )
    if not restored:
        db.add(
            Job(
                id=JOB,
                account_id=ACCOUNT,
                generation=1,
                kind="deletion",
                state="completed",
                body={"scope": "account", "journal_receipt": j.receipt},
                journal_accepted=True,
            )
        )
    if recovery:
        body, receipt = recovery
        db.add(
            SystemState(
                key="recovery",
                body={
                    "verified": True,
                    "recovery_id": body["recovery_id"],
                    "journal_activation": receipt,
                    "authentication_cutoff": body["authentication_cutoff"],
                    "inventory_sha256": body["inventory_sha256"],
                    "scopes_suspended": True,
                },
            )
        )
    db.commit()
    return db

services/api/tests/test_recovery_authori.body:
def test_recovery_claim_requires_latest_independent_activation_and_suspension(journal):
    act = activation(journal)
    authority = r.load_authority(journal.cfg, journal.instant)
    with database(journal) as db:
        with pytest.raises(r.RecoveryBlocked, match="recovery activation"):
            r.verify_database_authority(db, authority, False)
    with database(journal, recovery=act) as db:
        assert (
            r.verify_database_authority(db, authority, True)
            == act[0]["authentication_cutoff"]
        )
        state = db.get(SystemState, "recovery")
        original = deepcopy(state.body)
        for field, bad in [
            ("scopes_suspended", False),
            ("verified", False),
            ("recovery_id", "old"),
            ("inventory_sha256", "0" * 64),
            ("authentication_cutoff", 0),
            ("journal_activation", {}),
        ]:
            state.body = {**original, field: bad}
            with pytest.raises(r.RecoveryBlocked):
                r.verify_database_authority(db, authority, False)

def test_worker_claim_and_commit_refuse_retained_activation_missing_in_database(
    client, journal, monkeypatch
):
    from otgd.db import factory, Check
    from otgd import worker

    activation(journal)
    monkeypatch.setattr("otgd.config.settings", lambda: journal.cfg)
    monkeypatch.setattr("otgd.journal_continuity.verify_binding", lambda *_: None)
    with factory().begin() as db:
        db.add(Account(id=ACCOUNT, subject_hash=SUBJECT, generation=1, state="active"))
        db.add(
            Check(
                id="40000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
                account_id=ACCOUNT,
                generation=1,
                mode="controlled_research",
                state="processing",
            )
        )
        db.add(
            Job(
                id=JOB,
                account_id=ACCOUNT,
                generation=1,
                kind="result",
                state="pending",
                body={"session_id": "40000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"},
            )
        )
    with pytest.raises(Problem) as denied:
        worker.claim_job(JOB)
    assert denied.value.code == "INDEPENDENT_RECOVERY_NOT_VERIFIED"
    with factory().begin() as db:
        job = db.get(Job, JOB)
        assert job.state == "pending" and job.fence == 0
        job.state = "running"
        job.fence = 1
        job.lease_until = now() + 120
        job.started = now()
    claim = worker.Claim(
        JOB,
        ACCOUNT,
        1,
        "result",
        1,
        now(),
        {"session_id": "40000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"},
    )
    with pytest.raises(Problem):
        worker.execute_claim(claim)
    with pytest.raises(Problem):
        worker.commit_output(claim, {})
    with factory()() as db:
        assert db.get(Check, claim.body["session_id"]).result is None

def test_retained_database_never_automatically_adopts_journal(connection, monkeypatch):
    connection.execute(
        Account.__table__.insert().values(
            id="account", subject_hash="a" * 64, generation=1, state="active"
        )
    )
    journal = Journal()
    with pytest.raises(JournalContinuityBlocked, match="administrator"):
        preflight_bootstrap(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    with pytest.raises(JournalContinuityBlocked, match="automatically"):
        bind_migration(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    receipt = read_establishment(CONFIG, journal)["binding"]
    monkeypatch.setenv("OTGD_JOURNAL_ESTABLISHMENT_VERSION_ID", receipt["version_id"])
    monkeypatch.setenv("OTGD_JOURNAL_ESTABLISHMENT_SHA256", receipt["sha256"])
    preflight_bootstrap(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    assert (
        connection.scalar(select(SystemState.body).where(SystemState.key == STATE_KEY))
        is None
    )
    bind_migration(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    journal.version = "missing"
    with pytest.raises(JournalContinuityBlocked, match="unavailable"):
        preflight_bootstrap(connection, CONFIG, journal)

def test_empty_database_binds_once_then_requires_exact_version(connection):
    journal = Journal()
    assert preflight_bootstrap(connection, CONFIG, journal) is None
    receipt = bind_migration(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    assert receipt["body"] == BODY
    assert verify_binding(connection, CONFIG, journal) == receipt
    assert journal.stream.closed
    assert bind_migration(connection, CONFIG, journal) == receipt
    journal.version = "same-bytes-new-version"
    with pytest.raises(JournalContinuityBlocked, match="cannot be replaced"):
        bind_migration(connection, CONFIG, journal)
    with pytest.raises(JournalContinuityBlocked, match="do not match"):
        verify_binding(connection, CONFIG, journal)

def test_alcohol_expiry_between_contract_grant_and_start_rejects_cached_authority(client, account, monkeypatch, kind, offset):
    """Hypothetical inventory reaches real HTTP routes; never a hardware proof."""
    from uuid import uuid4
    from otgd import operator_governance as governance

    with factory().begin() as db:
        config, end, binding_id = alcohol_contract_authority(db, account, kind)
    consent(client, study(account))
    sid, aid, rid = (str(uuid4()) for _ in range(3))
    created = client.post("/v1/sessions", headers=headers(), json={"session_id": sid,
        "mode": "controlled_research", "study_id": STUDY, "protocol_id": PROTOCOL})
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    context = {"schema_version": "1.0.0", "session_id": sid, "context_confirmed_at": iso(),
        "profile_version_id": None, "profile_snapshot_sha256": "a" * 64, "history_snapshot_sha256": "b" * 64,
        "protocol_id": PROTOCOL, "configuration_refs": [{"id": config["registry_id"], "version": "v1",
            "sha256": config["sha256"], "scope": "measurement_collection"}],
        "baseline_refs": [], "device_associations": [{"binding_id": binding_id, "device_id": DEVICE,
            "hardware_revision": "fixture-hw", "firmware_version": "fixture-fw", "boot_id": "FICTIONAL-BOOT"}],
        "self_report_context": None}
    assert client.put(f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/context", headers=headers(revision=0), json=context).status_code == 200
    attempt = {"schema_version": "1.0.0", "session_id": sid, "attempt_id": aid, "component": "alcohol",
        "record_id": rid, "supersedes_attempt_id": None, "status": "started", "source": "prototype_sensor",
        "started_at": iso(), "ended_at": None, "configuration_id": config["registry_id"],
        "configuration_hash": config["sha256"], "quality_flags": [], "component_metadata": {},
        "artifact_refs": [], "attestation_refs": []}
    assert client.put(f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/attempts/{aid}", headers=headers(revision=0), json=attempt).status_code == 200
    request = {"attempt_id": aid, "channel": "alcohol", "binding_id": binding_id, "device_id": DEVICE,
        "configuration_id": config["registry_id"], "configuration_hash": config["sha256"]}
    # Only this synthetic configuration is admitted by a test-local inventory.
    # All lifecycle, consent, context, binding, expiry and signing code stays real.
    with monkeypatch.context() as hypothetical:
        hypothetical.setitem(governance.SOFTWARE_ADAPTERS, "alcohol", {config["software_adapter_id"]})
        cached = client.get("/v1/me/capabilities", headers=headers()).json()["channels"]["alcohol"]
        assert cached["available"] and cached["authorization_available"]
        granted = client.post(f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/capture-authorizations", headers=headers(), json=request)
        assert granted.status_code == 201, granted.text
    authorization = granted.json()
    assert authorization["state"] == "issued" and "server_start" not in authorization
    assert authorization["expires_epoch"] > end + offset
    assert cached["configurations"][0]["configuration_hash"] == config["sha256"]
    signed_starts = []
    def unexpected_start(*args, **kwargs):
        signed_starts.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("Expired alcohol authority must never mint a start token")
    monkeypatch.setattr("otgd.main.sign_start", unexpected_start)
    for module in ("otgd.operator_governance", "otgd.domain", "otgd.main"):
        monkeypatch.setattr(module + ".now", lambda: end + offset)
    path = f"/v1/sessions/{sid}/capture-authorizations"
    denied = client.post(path + "/" + authorization["authorization_id"] + "/start", headers=headers(),
        json={"attempt_id": aid, "device_boot_id": "FICTIONAL-BOOT", "device_nonce": "fictional-nonce"})
    assert denied.status_code == 403 and denied.json()["code"] == "APPROVED_REGISTRY_VERSION_REQUIRED", denied.text
    assert "server_start" not in denied.json()
    assert signed_starts == []
    fresh_grant = client.post(path, headers=headers(), json=request)
    assert fresh_grant.status_code == 403 and fresh_grant.json()["code"] == "APPROVED_REGISTRY_VERSION_REQUIRED", fresh_grant.text
    current = client.get("/v1/me/capabilities", headers=headers()).json()["channels"]["alcohol"]
    assert not current["available"] and not current["authorization_available"]
    assert current["configurations"] == [] and current["reason_codes"] == ["APPROVED_REGISTRY_VERSION_REQUIRED"]
    with factory()() as db:
        owner = db.get(Account, account)
        retained = record(db, owner, "authorization", authorization["authorization_id"])
        assert retained.body == authorization and retained.body["state"] == "issued"
        assert "server_start" not in retained.body
        assert record(db, owner, "alcohol", sid) is None
        assert record(db, owner, "alcohol", rid) is None
        registry_id = config["registry_id"] if kind == "configuration" else CALIBRATION
        assert history(db, kind, registry_id)["items"][0]["effective_state"] == "expired"
    assert not governance.SOFTWARE_ADAPTERS.get("alcohol")
    assert not governance.PHYSICAL_DRIVERS.get("alcohol")

def alcohol_contract_authority(db, account, expiry_kind):
    """Typed fictional dependency fixture; there is no breath instrument adapter."""
    from uuid import uuid4

    end = now() + 30
    config = configuration("alcohol", device_id=DEVICE, key_id=KEY, calibration_id=CALIBRATION,
        approved_hardware=["fixture-hw"], approved_firmware=["fixture-fw"],
        expires_at=end if expiry_kind == "configuration" else end + 3600)
    calibrated = {**calibration(), "channels": ["alcohol"],
        "expires_at": end if expiry_kind == "calibration" else end + 3600}
    config = validate_submission("configuration", config)
    for kind, value in (("study", study(account, {"alcohol": config["registry_id"]})),
        ("retention", retention()), ("device", device(account)), ("calibration", calibrated),
        ("qualification", proof("alcohol", config_body=config)), ("configuration", config)):
        approve(db, kind, value)
    binding_id = str(uuid4())
    save_record(db, db.get(Account, account), "binding", binding_id, {
        "binding_id": binding_id, "device_id": DEVICE, "key_id": KEY,
        "hardware_revision": "fixture-hw", "firmware_version": "fixture-fw", "state": "active"})
    return config, end, binding_id

services/api/tests/test_report_revisions.body:
def test_export_freezes_report_head_and_uses_separate_bounded_hash_indexed_files(
    client, laboratory
):
    first = accepted(client, laboratory)
    exported = client.post(
        "/v1/privacy/exports",
        headers=headers(),
        json={
            "selection": {"kind": "single", "session_ids": [laboratory.session_id]},
            "format": "json_zip",
            "include_raw": False,
        },
    )
    assert exported.status_code == 202, exported.text
    second = accepted(client, laboratory, body_for(laboratory, first))
    job_id = exported.json()["job_id"]
    assert run_job(job_id) == "completed"
    download = client.get(f"/v1/privacy/jobs/{job_id}/download", headers=headers())
    assert download.status_code == 200, download.text
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(download.content)) as archive:
        report_paths = [
            x for x in archive.namelist() if x.startswith("report-revisions/")
        ]
        assert report_paths == [
            f"report-revisions/{laboratory.session_id}/{first['revision_id']}.json"
        ]
        assert all(second["revision_id"] not in path for path in archive.namelist())
        check = strict_loads(archive.read(f"checks/{laboratory.session_id}.json"))
        index = check["report_revision_index"]
        assert len(canonical(index)) <= 16 * 1024 and len(index["items"]) == 1
        item = index["items"][0]
        raw = archive.read(item["path"])
        assert len(raw) == item["size_bytes"] <= 512 * 1024
        assert digest(strict_loads(raw)) == item["sha256"]
        assert strict_loads(raw) == first
        assert check["snapshot"] == laboratory.snapshot
        assert not any(x.endswith(".pdf") for x in archive.namelist())
        manifest = strict_loads(archive.read("manifest.json"))
        assert (
            next(x for x in manifest["files"] if x["path"] == item["path"])["sha256"]
            == item["sha256"]
        )

def body_for(lab, predecessor=None, kind="correction"):
    reading = deepcopy(lab.snapshot["saliva"][0])
    reading.update(
        measurement_id=str(uuid4()),
        value_ng_ml=6.0,
        measured_at=iso(now() - 30),
        original_report={"value": 6000.0, "unit": "pg/mL", "qualifier": "quantified"},
    )
    return {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "revision_id": str(uuid4()),
        "study_id": STUDY,
        "sample_id": lab.snapshot["sample"]["sample_id"],
        "base_snapshot_sha256": digest(lab.snapshot),
        "expected_previous_revision_id": predecessor["revision_id"]
        if predecessor
        else None,
        "expected_previous_revision_sha256": predecessor["revision_sha256"]
        if predecessor
        else None,
        "kind": kind,
        "reason_code": "CORRECTED_LABORATORY_REPORT"
        if kind == "correction"
        else "SPECIMEN_REANALYSIS",
        "reported_at": iso(now() - 10),
        "source_report_artifact_id": lab.artifact_id,
        "replacement_measurements": [reading],
    }

services/api/tests/test_security.py::tes.body:
def test_binding_challenge_is_single_use_and_owner_scoped(client, account):
    key = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    public = base64.b64encode(
        key.public_key().public_bytes(
            serialization.Encoding.DER, serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo
        )
    ).decode()
    with factory().begin() as db:
        from .governance_fixture import approve, common
        approve(db, "device", common("fixture-device:key1", device_id="fixture-device", key_id="key1",
            account_refs=[account], public_key_spki=public, hardware_revision="test", firmware_version="test",
            approved_protocol_ids=["fictional-test-protocol"]))
    r = client.post(
        "/v1/device-bindings/challenges",
        headers=headers(),
        json={"device_id": "fixture-device", "key_id": "key1"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    transcript = r.json()["transcript"]
    signature = base64.b64encode(
        key.sign(b"OTGD-BIND-v1\n" + canonical(transcript), ec.ECDSA(hashes.SHA256()))
    ).decode()
    body = {"challenge_id": r.json()["challenge_id"], "signature": signature}
    h = headers(key="bind-fixture")
    bound = client.post("/v1/device-bindings", headers=h, json=body)
    assert bound.status_code == 201
    assert (
        client.post("/v1/device-bindings", headers=h, json=body).json() == bound.json()
    )
    assert (
        client.post("/v1/device-bindings", headers=headers(), json=body).status_code
        == 409
    )
    assert client.get("/v1/device-bindings", headers=headers("b")).json()["items"] == []
    assert (
        client.delete(
            "/v1/device-bindings/" + bound.json()["binding_id"], headers=headers()
        ).status_code
        == 200
    )
    assert (
        client.get("/v1/device-bindings", headers=headers()).json()["items"][0]["state"]
        == "revoked"
    )

def test_profile_initial_missing_stale_etag_and_replay(client, account):
    body = {
        "profile": {
            "age_years": 25,
            "height_cm": 180.0,
            "weight_kg": 81.0,
            "bmi": 25.0,
            "recorded_at": iso(),
            "source": "self_report",
        },
        "history": {
            "use_frequency": "unknown",
            "route": "unknown",
            "time_since_use_min": None,
            "recent_exercise": None,
            "sleep_hours": None,
            "alcohol_co_use": "unknown",
        },
        "context": None,
    }
    assert (
        client.patch("/v1/me/profile", headers=headers(), json=body).status_code == 428
    )
    h = headers(key="profile-write", revision=0)
    r = client.patch("/v1/me/profile", headers=h, json=body)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    replay = client.patch("/v1/me/profile", headers=h, json=body)
    assert replay.json() == r.json()
    assert (
        client.patch(
            "/v1/me/profile", headers=headers(revision=0), json=body
        ).status_code
        == 412
    )
    changed = deepcopy(body)
    changed["profile"]["age_years"] = 26
    assert client.patch("/v1/me/profile", headers=h, json=changed).status_code == 409

def test_deletion_barrier_survives_journal_failure_and_same_key_resumes(
    client, account, store, monkeypatch
):
    s, c, m = upload(client, account)
    finalize(client, s, m)
    original = storage.journal_accept

    def fail(*args):
        raise Problem(503, "JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE")

    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "journal_accept", fail)
    h = headers(key="delete-once")
    body = {"scope": "all_data", "confirmation": True}
    first = client.post("/v1/privacy/deletion-requests", headers=h, json=body)
    assert first.status_code == 503
    with factory()() as db:
        a = db.get(Account, account)
        assert a.generation == 2 and a.state == "deleting"
    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "journal_accept", original)
    accepted = client.post("/v1/privacy/deletion-requests", headers=h, json=body)
    assert accepted.status_code == 202
    id = accepted.json()["job_id"]
    assert run_job(id) == "completed"
    with factory()() as db:
        assert not db.get(Check, s["session_id"])
        assert db.get(Account, account).state == "awaiting_generation_ack"
    assert (
        client.post(
            "/v1/me/data-generation/acknowledgments",
            headers=headers(gen=2),
            json={"confirmation": True},
        ).status_code
        == 200
    )
    old = client.post(
        "/v1/sessions",
        headers=headers(),
        json={"session_id": str(uuid4()), "mode": "synthetic"},
    )
    assert old.status_code == 410
    assert (
        client.post("/v1/privacy/deletion-requests", headers=h, json=body).json()[
            "job_id"
        ]
        == id
    )

def test_receipt_update_is_denied_in_postgres_without_blocking_privacy_deletion(client, account):
    assert engine().dialect.name == "postgresql", "Mandatory live gate requires real PostgreSQL"
    with engine().begin() as connection:
        migration_005_participant_acquisition(connection)
        migration_005_participant_acquisition(connection)
    for kind in IMMUTABLE_KINDS:
        with factory().begin() as db:
            owner = db.get(Account, account)
            row = save_record(db, owner, kind, uid(), {"fixture": "immutable-software-receipt"})
            db.flush()
            identity = row.id
        with factory()() as db:

    reinvited = document(account, version="v2", invitation="coordinator-new-invitation", text="Changed fictional document")
    approve(reinvited)
    assert submit(client, acceptance(reinvited)).status_code == 201

def test_instruction_receipt_expiry_uses_declared_time_and_replay_does_not_restore_authority(collection_scope, client, monkeypatch):

    denied = client.post(f"/v1/sessions/{run['session_id']}/capture-authorizations", headers=headers(), json={

def test_actual_http_delegated_ticket_completion_import_and_minimal_dedup(client, handoff, monkeypatch):
    store, ticket, source_headers = http_source(client, handoff, monkeypatch)
    source = ticket["artifact_id"]
    replay = client.post("/v1/research/lab-source-artifact-uploads", headers=source_headers, json=handoff.request.data())
    assert replay.status_code == 201 and replay.json()["artifact_id"] == source
    assert replay.json()["expires_at"] == ticket["expires_at"]
    assert store.ticket_calls[-1][1]["ExpiresIn"] <= store.ticket_calls[0][1]["ExpiresIn"]
    complete = client.post(f"/v1/research/lab-source-artifact-uploads/{source}/complete", headers=headers("b"),
        json={key: handoff.request.data()[key] for key in ("sha256", "size_bytes", "media_type")})
    assert complete.status_code == 200, complete.text
    body = import_body(handoff, source).data()
    import_headers = headers("b", key="fictional-delegated-import")
    imported = client.post("/v1/research/lab-imports", headers=import_headers, json=body)
    assert imported.status_code == 201, imported.text
    repeat = client.post("/v1/research/lab-imports", headers=import_headers, json=body)
    assert repeat.status_code == 201 and repeat.json() == imported.json()
    status = client.get(f"/v1/sessions/{body['session_id']}/collections/{body['sample_id']}", headers=headers())
    assert status.status_code == 200, status.text
    assert status.json()["state"] == "analysis_available"
    assert status.json()["attempt"]["attempt_id"] == imported.json()["analysis_attempt_id"]
    with factory().begin() as db:
        artifact = db.get(Artifact, source)
        assert artifact.account_id == handoff.participant
        assert artifact.version_id == "fictional-version-1"
        for row in db.scalars(select(Dedup).where(Dedup.account_id == handoff.operator,
            Dedup.route.like("%/research/lab%"))):
            assert not ({"measurements", "upload_url", "required_headers", "account_ref", "sample_id"} & set(row.body))
            assert handoff.pdf.decode() not in str(row.body)
    with factory().begin() as db:
        target = db.get(Account, handoff.participant)
        consent = record(db, target, "consent", body["study_id"])
        consent.body = {**consent.body, "state": "withdrawn"}
        consent.sha256 = digest(consent.body)
    denied = client.post("/v1/research/lab-imports", headers=import_headers, json=body)
    assert denied.status_code == 403, denied.text
    denied_ticket = client.post("/v1/research/lab-source-artifact-uploads", headers=source_headers,
        json=handoff.request.data())
    assert denied_ticket.status_code == 403, denied_ticket.text

def test_pending_sample_blocks_finalization_until_explicit_cancellation_without_erasing_history(collection_scope, client):
    run = acknowledge_and_start(client, start_collection(client, collection_scope))
    path = f"/v1/sessions/{run['session_id']}"
    collected = client.post(path + "/collections", headers=headers(), json=collection_body(run))
    assert collected.status_code == 201, collected.text
    pending = client.post(path + "/finalize", headers=headers(revision=1), json={
        "snapshot_sha256": "a" * 64, "evidence_sha256": "b" * 64})
    assert pending.status_code == 409 and pending.json()["code"] == "LAB_ANALYSIS_PENDING"
    original = collected.json()
    h = headers()
    request = {"confirmation": True, "reason": "PARTICIPANT_DECLINED"}
    canceled = client.post(path + f"/collections/{run['sample_id']}/abandon", headers=h, json=request)
    assert canceled.status_code == 201, canceled.text
    replay = client.post(path + f"/collections/{run['sample_id']}/abandon", headers=h, json=request)
    assert replay.status_code == 201 and replay.json() == canceled.json()
    status = client.get(path + f"/collections/{run['sample_id']}", headers=headers())
    assert status.status_code == 200 and status.json()["state"] == "analysis_canceled"
    assert status.json()["request"] == original["request"]
    assert status.json()["attempt"] == original["attempt"]
    assert status.json()["projection"] == original["projection"]
    assert status.json()["projection"]["sample"]["status"] == "valid"
    assert status.json()["projection"]["saliva"] == []
    write_review_fixture("abandon_flow", {"configuration": run["config"], "context": run["context"],
        "ack_request": run["ack"], "instruction_receipt": run["receipt"], "authorization": run["grant"],
        "start": run["start"], "collection_request": original["request"], "collection_receipt": original,
        "abandon_request": request, "abandon_receipt": canceled.json(), "abandon_status": status.json()})
    with factory()() as db:
        owner = db.get(Account, run["account"])
        assert record(db, owner, "collection", run["sample_id"]).body == original
        require_completed_collections(db, owner, db.get(Check, run["session_id"]))

def login(aws,c):
    if not shutil.which('docker'):raise Gate('Docker is unavailable; image build/promotion is unexecuted')
    auth=aws.client('ecr').get_authorization_token(registryIds=[c['account']])['authorizationData'][0]
    username,password=base64.b64decode(auth['authorizationToken']).decode().split(':',1)
    registry=auth['proxyEndpoint'].removeprefix('https://')
    # Docker stores this token in the caller's credential helper; never argv/logs.
    run(['docker','login','--username',username,'--password-stdin',registry],input=password,capture=True)
    return registry+'/otgd-'+c['environment']

def require_trusted_signer(private_path,public_path):
    if not public_path:raise Gate('Supply an independently trusted --trusted-public-key before signing')
    trusted=serialization.load_pem_public_key(bounded_file(public_path,8192))

        trusted.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PublicFormat.Raw)!=actual.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PublicFormat.Raw)):

def verify_maintenance(aws,out,path,c,operation):
    if not path or not path.exists():raise Gate('Supply the successful '+operation+' receipt')
    receipt=bounded_json(path)
    if (operation not in ('migrate','restore','verify-admission') or receipt.get('operation')!=operation or receipt.get('status')!='passed'
        or receipt.get('image_digest')!=c['imageDigest'] or receipt.get('environment')!=c['environment']
        or receipt.get('release_id')!=c['releaseId'] or receipt.get('account')!=c['account'] or receipt.get('region')!=c['region']
        or not isinstance(receipt.get('task_arn'),str)):raise Gate('Maintenance receipt does not match this release/account/region')
    result=aws.client('ecs').describe_tasks(cluster=out['Cluster'],tasks=[receipt['task_arn']])
    if result.get('failures') or len(result.get('tasks',[]))!=1:raise Gate('Maintenance task is no longer verifiable; rerun the bounded maintenance operation')
    completed=result['tasks'][0]
    containers=completed.get('containers',[])
    if (completed.get('lastStatus')!='STOPPED' or completed.get('taskArn')!=receipt['task_arn']
        or completed.get('clusterArn')!=out['Cluster'] or completed.get('taskDefinitionArn')!=out['MigrationTaskDefinition']
        or completed.get('startedBy')!='otgd-reviewed-maintenance' or len(containers)!=1
        or containers[0].get('name')!='migration' or type(containers[0].get('exitCode')) is not int or containers[0]['exitCode']!=0):raise Gate('Exact deployed maintenance task did not complete successfully')
    definition=aws.client('ecs').describe_task_definition(taskDefinition=completed['taskDefinitionArn'])['taskDefinition']
    definitions=definition.get('containerDefinitions',[])
    dns='amazonaws.com.cn' if c['region'].startswith('cn-') else 'amazonaws.com'
    expected_image=f"{c['account']}.dkr.ecr.{c['region']}.{dns}/otgd-{c['environment']}@{c['imageDigest']}"
    if (definition.get('taskDefinitionArn')!=out['MigrationTaskDefinition'] or len(definitions)!=1
        or definitions[0].get('name')!='migration' or definitions[0].get('image')!=expected_image):raise Gate('Maintenance executed a different task definition or image')
    overrides=completed.get('overrides')
    if not isinstance(overrides,dict) or set(overrides)!={'containerOverrides'} or len(overrides['containerOverrides'])!=1:raise Gate('Unexpected maintenance task/role/resource overrides')
    override=overrides['containerOverrides'][0]
    if not isinstance(override,dict) or not {'name','command'}.issubset(override) or set(override)-{'name','command','environment'} or override['name']!='migration':raise Gate('Unexpected maintenance container overrides')
    expected=['uv','run','--no-sync','python','-m','otgd.migrate'];environment=[]
    if operation=='verify-admission':
        expected=['uv','run','--no-sync','python','-m','otgd.recovery_authority']
        stopped=completed.get('stoppedAt')
        try:finished=datetime.fromisoformat(receipt.get('finished_at','').replace('Z','+00:00'))
        except (ValueError,TypeError):raise Gate('Admission receipt needs its actual UTC completion time') from None
        now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if (not isinstance(stopped,datetime) or stopped.tzinfo is None or finished.tzinfo is None or finished.utcoffset().total_seconds()!=0 or
            not 0<=(now-stopped).total_seconds()<=900 or not 0<=(now-finished).total_seconds()<=900 or abs((finished-stopped).total_seconds())>60):
            raise Gate('Independent journal admission task must be fresh and bound to actual ECS completion')
    if operation=='restore':
        timestamp=receipt.get('backup_created_at')
        if not c.get('recoveryRequired') or not isinstance(timestamp,str):raise Gate('Restore receipt requires the reviewed recovery point')
        try:point=datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z','+00:00'))
        except ValueError:raise Gate('Invalid restore recovery timestamp') from None
        if point.tzinfo is None or point.utcoffset().total_seconds()!=0 or point>datetime.now(timezone.utc):raise Gate('Restore recovery timestamp must be a past UTC point')
        if c.get('databaseSnapshotIdentifier'):
            snapshot=aws.client('rds').describe_db_snapshots(DBSnapshotIdentifier=c['databaseSnapshotIdentifier'])['DBSnapshots'][0]
            actual=snapshot.get('OriginalSnapshotCreateTime',snapshot['SnapshotCreateTime'])
            if abs((point-actual).total_seconds())>1:raise Gate('Restore receipt differs from the selected actual snapshot point')
        expected=['uv','run','--no-sync','python','/app/scripts/restore-journal.py','--backup-created-at',timestamp,'--confirm-quiesced']
        environment=[{'name':'OTGD_RECOVERY_REQUIRED','value':'true'}]
    if override['command']!=expected or override.get('environment',[])!=environment:raise Gate('Maintenance command/environment does not match the exact reviewed operation')

def test_signed_issue_and_attestation_receipt_anchors_cannot_be_rewritten(client, account):
    from otgd.canonical import digest
    from otgd.db import Record
    assert engine().dialect.name == "postgresql", "Mandatory live gate requires real PostgreSQL"
    with engine().begin() as connection:
        migration_005_participant_acquisition(connection)
        migration_006_cardiac_interval_anchors(connection)
        migration_006_cardiac_interval_anchors(connection)
    with factory().begin() as db:
        owner = db.get(Account, account)
        attestation = save_record(db, owner, "attestation", uid(), {"fixture": "signed-custody-evidence"})
        authorization = save_record(db, owner, "authorization", uid(), {"state": "issued", "scope": "unchanged"})
        db.flush()
        attestation_id, authorization_id = attestation.id, authorization.id
    for identity, sql in ((attestation_id, "created=created-100"), (attestation_id, "body='{}'"),
        (authorization_id, "created=created-100"), (authorization_id, "body='{}'")):
        with factory()() as db:
            with pytest.raises(DBAPIError) as denied:
                db.execute(text(f"UPDATE records SET {sql} WHERE id=:id"), {"id": identity})
            assert denied.value.orig.sqlstate == "42501"
            db.rollback()
    with factory().begin() as db:
        row = db.get(Record, authorization_id)
        row.body = {**row.body, "state": "started", "device_boot_id": None,
            "server_started_at": "2026-10-11T00:00:00Z", "server_started_epoch": 1791676800.0,
            "server_start": {"domain": "OTGD capture grant v1\0", "fixture": "signature checked separately by application"}}
        row.sha256 = digest(row.body)
    for sql in ("created=created+1", "body='{}'", "sha256='fake'", "revision=revision+1"):
        with factory()() as db:
            with pytest.raises(DBAPIError) as denied:
                db.execute(text(f"UPDATE records SET {sql} WHERE id=:id"), {"id": authorization_id})
            assert denied.value.orig.sqlstate == "42501"
            db.rollback()
    with factory().begin() as db:
        db.execute(text("DELETE FROM records WHERE id IN (:attestation,:authorization)"),
            {"attestation": attestation_id, "authorization": authorization_id})

def test_unsigned_timing_or_channel_changes_cannot_qualify(cardiac, change):
    db, owner, check = resolved(cardiac)
    with db:
        admitted = m.execution_authority(db, owner, check)
    snapshot, interval = deepcopy(cardiac.snapshot), deepcopy(admitted["cardiac_timing"])
    if change == "unknown_flag": snapshot["cardiac"]["quality_flags"].append("CONTACT_LOST")
    elif change == "missing_flag": snapshot["cardiac"]["quality_flags"].pop()
    elif change == "ecg": snapshot["cardiac"]["modality"] = "ecg"
    elif change == "rmssd": snapshot["cardiac"]["ecg_rmssd_ms"] = 20.0
    elif change == "width": interval["interval_ms"] -= 1
    elif change == "span": interval["acquisition_bound_ms"] -= 1
    elif change == "snapshot": snapshot["cardiac"]["heart_rate_bpm"] = 120.0
    else: interval["received_epoch"] = now() + 10
    with pytest.raises(Problem, match="CARDIAC_SERVER_INTERVAL_INVALID"):
        c.validate_interval(snapshot, cardiac.body, interval)

def test_baseline_requires_independent_original_interval_same_scope_and_conservative_age(cardiac):
    db, owner, check = resolved(cardiac)
    with db:
        current = m.execution_authority(db, owner, check)["cardiac_timing"]
    body = deepcopy(cardiac.body)

def verify_current_execution(db, account, check, output):
    if output.get("schema_version") != "1.1.0":
        return
    validate_result(output)
    resolved = execution_authority(db, account, check)
    if (
        resolved["proof"]["authority_sha256"]
        != output["model_execution"]["authority_sha256"]
        or resolved["proof"]["capture_context_sha256"]
        != output["model_execution"]["capture_context_sha256"]
        or resolved["proof"]["evidence_manifest_sha256"]

    ):
        raise Problem(403, "MODEL_AUTHORITY_CHANGED")

def execution_authority(db, account, check):
    """Resolve actual released records and owner evidence; no request approval flags."""
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from .config import settings
    from .db import Check, RegistryEvent, SystemState
    from .domain import NOTICE_SHA, record, verify_evidence
    from .operator_governance import released_version, validate_dependencies

    if (
        account.state != "active"
        or account.generation != check.generation
        or account.notice != NOTICE_SHA
        or check.mode != "controlled_research"
    ):
        raise Problem(403, "STUDY_UNAUTHORIZED")
    recovery = db.get(SystemState, "recovery")
    if recovery:
        from .recovery_scopes import require_study_scope

        require_study_scope(db, check.study_id, account)
    study = released_version(db, "study", check.study_id)
    if (
        account.id not in study.body["account_refs"]
        or study.body["protocol_id"] != check.protocol_id
        or not study.body.get("model_id")
    ):
        raise Problem(403, "STUDY_UNAUTHORIZED")
    consent = record(db, account, "consent", check.study_id)
    if (
        not consent
        or consent.body.get("state") != "active"
        or any(
            consent.body.get(k) != study.body[k]
            for k in ("invitation_id", "document_version", "document_sha256")
        )
    ):
        raise Problem(403, "CURRENT_CONSENT_REQUIRED")
    model = released_version(db, "model", study.body["model_id"])
    body = model.body
    validate_registry_model(body)
    validate_dependencies(db, "model", body)
    if check.study_id not in body["study_ids"]:
        raise Problem(403, "STUDY_UNAUTHORIZED")
    context, manifest = verify_evidence(db, account, check)
    calibration = released_version(
        db, "calibration", body["manifest"]["calibration_id"]
    )
    timing_qualified, timing_bias_ms, timing_sha256 = capture_authority(
        db, account, check, body, manifest
    )
    optical_qualified, optical_sha256 = optical_authority(
        db, account, check, body, manifest
    )
    from .cardiac_authority import build_authority
    from .cardiac_authority import resolve as resolve_cardiac

    cardiac_timing = resolve_cardiac(db, account, check, body, manifest)
    if cardiac_timing is not None:
        # Publication, historical reads and exports re-admit at the current
        # service time; an old evaluation timestamp cannot renew custody age.
        scope_check(check.snapshot, body, timing_qualified,
            optical_qualified=optical_qualified, cardiac_timing=cardiac_timing)
    baseline_cardiac_timing = None
    baseline = None
    if body["manifest"]["baseline_mode"] == "personalized":
        original = (
            db.get(Check, check.snapshot["baseline_ref"])
            if check.snapshot.get("baseline_ref")
            else None
        )
        if (
            not original
            or original.account_id != account.id
            or original.generation != account.generation
            or original.state != "completed"
            or not original.snapshot
        ):
            raise Problem(422, "BASELINE_NOT_COMPATIBLE")
        _, baseline_manifest = verify_evidence(db, account, original)
        baseline_timing, _, baseline_timing_sha = capture_authority(
            db, account, original, body, baseline_manifest
        )
        baseline_optical, baseline_optical_sha = optical_authority(
            db, account, original, body, baseline_manifest
        )
        baseline_cardiac_timing = resolve_cardiac(db, account, original, body, baseline_manifest)
        if (
            baseline_timing_sha != timing_sha256
            or baseline_optical_sha != optical_sha256
        ):
            raise Problem(422, "BASELINE_NOT_COMPATIBLE")
        scope_check(
            original.snapshot,
            body,
            baseline_timing,
            baseline=True,
            optical_qualified=baseline_optical,
            cardiac_timing=baseline_cardiac_timing,
        )
        baseline = original.snapshot
        if cardiac_timing is not None:
            from .cardiac_authority import validate_baseline

            validate_baseline(check.snapshot, body, cardiac_timing, baseline_cardiac_timing)
    ref = ArtifactRef.model_validate(body["artifact_ref"]).model_dump()
    if ref["bucket"] != settings().artifact_bucket:
        raise Problem(403, "MODEL_ARTIFACT_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    decisions = list(
        db.scalars(
            select(RegistryEvent)
            .where(RegistryEvent.version_id == model.id)
            .order_by(RegistryEvent.revision)
        )
    )
    authority = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "model_manifest": body["manifest"],
        "model_registry_version": model.version,
        "model_registry_sha256": model.sha256,
        "model_artifact_sha256": ref["sha256"],
        "evaluation_report_sha256": digest(body["evaluation_report"]),
        "calibration_sha256": calibration.sha256,
        "native_timing_calibration_sha256": timing_sha256,
        "quality_policy_sha256": digest(body["quality_policy"]),
        "co_use_policy_sha256": digest(body["co_use_policy"]),
        "compatibility_policy_sha256": digest(body["compatibility_policy"]),
        "study_approval_sha256": study.sha256,
        "consent_sha256": consent.sha256,
        "registry_events_sha256": digest(
            [
                {
                    "revision": r.revision,
                    "state": r.state,
                    "principal": r.principal,
                    "sha256": r.submitted_sha256,
                }
                for r in decisions
            ]
        ),
    }
    cardiac_companion = build_authority(body, cardiac_timing, baseline_cardiac_timing)
    if cardiac_companion is not None:
        authority["cardiac_authority"] = cardiac_companion
    proof = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "registry_id": body["model_id"],
        "registry_version": model.version,
        "manifest_sha256": digest(body["manifest"]),
        "model_artifact_sha256": ref["sha256"],
        "evaluation_report_sha256": digest(body["evaluation_report"]),
        "feature_version": body["manifest"]["feature_version"],
        "feature_values_sha256": "0" * 64,
        "calibration_id": body["manifest"]["calibration_id"],
        "calibration_sha256": calibration.sha256,
        "capture_context_sha256": context.sha256,
        "evidence_manifest_sha256": manifest.sha256,
        "baseline_sha256": digest(baseline) if baseline else None,
        "authority_sha256": digest(authority),
        "endpoint_definition": body["manifest"]["endpoint_definition"],
        "population_description": body["manifest"]["population"]["description"],
        "authority_manifest": authority,
    }
    return {
        "body": body,
        "ref": ref,
        "proof": proof,
        "baseline": baseline,
        "timing_qualified": timing_qualified,
        "timing_bias_ms": timing_bias_ms,
        "optical_qualified": optical_qualified,
        "cardiac_timing": cardiac_timing,
        "baseline_cardiac_timing": baseline_cardiac_timing,
        "calibration": calibration.body,
    }

def validate_result(value):
    from .domain import validate_schema

    validate_schema(value, "research/ResearchResult.schema.json")
    from .cardiac_authority import validate_result_companion

    validate_result_companion(value)
    if "simulated" in value["provenance_summary"]:
        raise Problem(422, "SIMULATED_INPUT")
    proof = value["model_execution"]
    authority, manifest = (
        proof["authority_manifest"],
        proof["authority_manifest"]["model_manifest"],
    )
    if (
        digest(authority) != proof["authority_sha256"]
        or digest(manifest) != proof["manifest_sha256"]
        or manifest["model_id"] != value["model_id"]
        or manifest["lifecycle"] != "active_research"
        or manifest["endpoint_id"] != value["endpoint_id"]
        or manifest["artifact_sha256"] != proof["model_artifact_sha256"]
        or authority["model_artifact_sha256"] != proof["model_artifact_sha256"]
        or authority["evaluation_report_sha256"] != proof["evaluation_report_sha256"]
        or authority["calibration_sha256"] != proof["calibration_sha256"]
        or authority["model_registry_version"] != proof["registry_version"]
        or manifest["calibration_id"] != proof["calibration_id"]
        or manifest["feature_version"] != proof["feature_version"]
        or manifest["endpoint_definition"] != proof["endpoint_definition"]
        or manifest["population"]["description"] != proof["population_description"]
        or (
            value["state"] == "research_estimate"
            and manifest["operating_threshold"] != value["operating_threshold"]
        )
    ):
        raise Problem(422, "MODEL_EXECUTION_PROOF_MISMATCH")
    policy = manifest["uncertainty_policy"]
    if (
        proof["registry_id"] != manifest["model_id"]
        or value["uncertainty_policy_id"] != policy["policy_id"]
        or (manifest["baseline_mode"] == "personalized")
        != (proof["baseline_sha256"] is not None)
    ):
        raise Problem(422, "MODEL_EXECUTION_PROOF_MISMATCH")
    if value["state"] == "research_estimate":
        probability = value["probability"]
        classification = (
            "above_threshold"
            if probability >= manifest["operating_threshold"]
            else "below_threshold"
        )
        if (
            value["classification"] != classification
            or value["reason_codes"]
            or policy["method"] == "probability_band"
            and policy["lower"] <= probability <= policy["upper"]
        ):
            raise Problem(422, "MODEL_EXECUTION_PROOF_MISMATCH")
    elif policy["method"] != "probability_band" or value["reason_codes"] != [
        "UNCERTAINTY_ABSTENTION"
    ]:
        raise Problem(422, "MODEL_EXECUTION_PROOF_MISMATCH")
    return value

def test_private_signing_key_is_regular_private_bounded_and_single_link(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);path=root/'private.pem'
            key=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
            raw=key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption())
            path.write_bytes(raw);path.chmod(0o600)
            self.assertEqual(d.private_key(path).private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PrivateFormat.Raw,serialization.NoEncryption()),
                key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.Raw,serialization.PrivateFormat.Raw,serialization.NoEncryption()))
            symbolic=root/'symbolic.pem';symbolic.symlink_to(path)
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(symbolic)
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(root)
            linked=root/'linked.pem';os.link(path,linked)
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(path)
            linked.unlink()
            path.chmod(0o644)
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(path)
            path.chmod(0o600)
            with patch.object(d.os,'getuid',return_value=os.getuid()+1),self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(path)
            path.write_bytes(b'x'*8193)
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(path)
            path.write_bytes(b'not an Ed25519 private key')
            with self.assertRaises(d.Gate):d.private_key(path)

def test_plan_is_pure_and_profiles_cannot_publish_automatically(
    config, tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        store,
        "source_revision",
        lambda: pytest.fail("plan must not inspect source/network"),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        store, "Eas", lambda *a: pytest.fail("plan must not launch an external tool")
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        store,
        "private_file",
        lambda *a: pytest.fail("plan must not open credential files"),
    )
    result = store.execute(
        argparse.Namespace(
            action="plan", config=write_config(config, tmp_path), platform="android"
        )
    )
    assert (
        result["action"] == "plan_only"
        and result["required_gates"] == 13
        and result["public_release"] is False
    )
    profiles = json.loads((ROOT / "apps/mobile/eas.json").read_text())
    assert profiles["cli"] == {
        "version": store.EAS_VERSION,
        "appVersionSource": "remote",
        "requireCommit": True,
    }
    for name, environment in (("qa-store", "qa"), ("production", "prod")):
        p = profiles["build"][name]
        assert (
            p["distribution"] == "store"
            and p["android"]["buildType"] == "app-bundle"
            and p["ios"]["simulator"] is False
        )
        assert (
            p["autoIncrement"] is True
            and p["env"]["EXPO_PUBLIC_HOSTED_PREVIEW"] == "false"
            and p["env"]["APP_ENV"] == environment
        )
        assert profiles["submit"][name]["android"]["releaseStatus"] == "draft"
        assert profiles["submit"][name]["android"]["changesNotSentForReview"] is True
    assert profiles["build"]["qa"]["distribution"] == "internal"

def test_pinned_tool_package_integrity_and_actual_public_eas_variable_scope(
    config, tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    files = {
        "bin/run": b"FICTIONAL CLI EXECUTION BOUNDARY",
        "package.json": b'{"name":"eas-cli"}',
    }
    packed = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=packed, mode="w:gz") as output:
        for name, content in files.items():
            item = tarfile.TarInfo("package/" + name)
            item.size = len(content)
            output.addfile(item, io.BytesIO(content))
    archive = packed.getvalue()
    expected = "sha512-" + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(archive).digest()).decode()
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "EAS_INTEGRITY", expected)
    old_client = httpx.Client
    corrupt = [False]

    def handler(request):
        if request.url.path.endswith(".tgz"):
            return httpx.Response(
                200, content=archive + (b"changed" if corrupt[0] else b"")
            )
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "version": store.EAS_VERSION,
                "dist": {
                    "integrity": expected,
                    "tarball": "https://registry.npmjs.org/eas-cli/-/eas-cli-"
                    + store.EAS_VERSION
                    + ".tgz",
                },
            },
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        store.httpx,
        "Client",
        lambda **kwargs: old_client(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), **kwargs),
    )
    manifest = store.verify_eas_package()
    corrupt[0] = True
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="integrity verification"):
        store.verify_eas_package()
    monkeypatch.delenv("EXPO_TOKEN", raising=False)
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="EXPO_TOKEN"):
        store.Eas(tmp_path, config)
    monkeypatch.setenv("EXPO_TOKEN", "TEST_ONLY_AUTH_BOUNDARY")
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "verify_eas_package", lambda: manifest)
    tool = tmp_path / "distribution/eas-toolchain"
    tool.mkdir(parents=True)
    (tool / "package-lock.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"packages": {"node_modules/eas-cli": {"integrity": expected}}})
    )
    seen = []

    def run_tool(args, **kw):
        seen.append((args, kw))
        if args[0] == "npm":
            assert "EXPO_TOKEN" not in kw["env"]
            for name, content in files.items():
                path = tool / "node_modules/eas-cli" / name
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_bytes(content)
            return ""
        assert args[:2] == ["node", str(tool / "node_modules/eas-cli/bin/run")]
        assert kw["env"]["EXPO_TOKEN"] == "TEST_ONLY_AUTH_BOUNDARY"
        if args[-1] == "--version":
            return "eas-cli/" + store.EAS_VERSION + " linux-x64 node-v24"
        if args[-1] == "project:info":
            return f"fullName  @{config['expo_account']}/{store.SLUG}\nID        {PROJECT}\n"
        name = args[args.index("--variable-name") + 1]
        return (
            name
            + "="
            + {
                "EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL": config["api_url"],
                "EXPO_PUBLIC_OAUTH_ISSUER": config["oauth_issuer"],
                "EXPO_PUBLIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID": config["oauth_client_id"],
                "EXPO_PUBLIC_OAUTH_ORIGIN": config["oauth_origin"],
                "EXPO_PUBLIC_OAUTH_WEB_CALLBACK_URI": config["oauth_web_callback_uri"],
            }[name]
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "command", run_tool)
    eas = store.Eas(tmp_path, config)
    eas.verify_project(config)
    eas.verify_environment(config)
    assert len(seen) == 8
    assert all(
        "--scope" not in command or command[command.index("--scope") + 1] == "project"
        for command, _ in seen
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(eas, "run", lambda *args: "")
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="absent"):
        eas.verify_environment(config)
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="project/account"):
        eas.verify_project(config)
    (tool / "node_modules/eas-cli/bin/run").write_bytes(b"altered installed CLI")
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="executable source"):
        store.verify_cli_tree(tool / "node_modules/eas-cli", manifest)

def test_clean_isolated_source_preserves_exact_git_revision_and_excludes_untracked_files(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    original = tmp_path / "canonical"
    (original / "apps/mobile").mkdir(parents=True)
    (original / "apps/mobile/eas.json").write_text("{}")
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", str(original)], check=True, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "apps/mobile/eas.json"], cwd=original, check=True)
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "user.name=Fictional unit",
            "-c",
            "user.email=unit@invalid",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            "fictional unit source",
        ],
        cwd=original,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    revision = store.source_revision(original)
    (original / "preserved-legacy-untracked.txt").write_text(
        "must never enter EAS upload"
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "ROOT", original)
    copy = store.isolated_source(revision, tmp_path / "stage")
    assert (
        store.source_revision(copy.parents[1]) == revision
        and not (copy.parents[1] / "preserved-legacy-untracked.txt").exists()
    )
    (original / "apps/mobile/eas.json").write_text('{"modified":true}')
    with pytest.raises(store.Gate, match="clean committed"):
        store.source_revision(original)

def test_exact_build_inspection_then_explicit_draft_submission_and_status_have_signed_distinct_receipts(
    flow, config, platform
):
    args, events, _ = flow
    args.platform = platform
    result = store.execute(args)
    assert (
        result["purpose"] == "mobile-store-build"
        and result["store_availability"] == "not_submitted"
    )
    build_path = args.output
    args.action, args.receipt, args.output = (
        "submit",
        build_path,
        build_path.parent / "submission-receipt.json",
    )
    result = store.execute(args)
    assert (
        result["public_release"] is False
        and result["store_availability"] == "not_verified"
    )
    assert any(isinstance(e, list) and e[0] == "submit:view" for e in events)
    intent = store.verify_signed_record(
        Path(str(args.output) + ".intent.json"), args.trusted_public_key
    )
    assert intent["build_id"] == BUILD and intent["platform"] == platform
    args.action, args.submission_receipt = "status", args.output
    result = store.execute(args)
    assert (
        result["eas_submission_status"] == "FINISHED"
        and result["store_availability"] == "not_verified"
    )
